BOOK ONE · LESSON 143

A walk through the woods

林中散步

A story lesson. The narrator lives in a very old town surrounded by beautiful woods, a famous beauty spot. On Sundays, hundreds of people come from the city to see the town and to walk through the woods. Visitors have been asked to keep the woods clean and tidy, and litter baskets have been placed under the trees, but people still throw their rubbish everywhere. Last Wednesday, the narrator went for a walk in the woods and was made very sad by what he saw: seven old cars and three old refrigerators, empty litter baskets, and the ground covered with pieces of paper, cigarette ends, old tyres, empty bottles and rusty tins. Among the rubbish he found a sign which said, 'Anyone who leaves litter in these woods will be prosecuted!' The lesson introduces the passive voice with present and past perfect ('have been asked', 'have been placed', 'have been painted'), the relative clauses 'which is surrounded', 'which said', and the noun clause 'What I saw made me very sad'. The workbook drills story comprehension and short answers; the grammar workbook practices giving correct replies with 'I don't need to ... . It/They have already been ...'.

Lesson 课文

Listen then answer this question. 听录音，然后回答题目。

听录音，然后回答题目。

A walk through the woods. 林中散步。I live in a very old town which is surrounded by beautiful woods. It is a famous beauty spot. On Sundays, hundreds of people come from the city to see our town and to walk through the woods. Visitors have been asked to keep the woods clean and tidy. Litter baskets have been placed under the trees, but people still throw their rubbish everywhere. Last Wednesday, I went for a walk in the woods. What I saw made me very sad. I counted seven old cars and three old refrigerators. The litter baskets were empty and the ground was covered with pieces of paper, cigarette ends, old tyres, empty bottles and rusty tins. Among the rubbish, I found a sign which said, 'Anyone who leaves litter in these woods will be prosecuted!'

林中散步。我住在一个由美丽的树林环绕的古老小镇上。这是一个著名的风景胜地。每逢星期天，有许许多多的人从城里来参观我们的小镇，并在树林中散步。游客已被告知要保持树林的整洁。树下都已设置了废物筐，但是人们仍到处扔垃圾。上星期三我到树林里去散步。我所见到的一切使我非常难过。我数了一下，有7辆旧汽车和3个旧冰箱。废物筐是空的，而满地都是纸片、烟头、旧轮胎、空瓶子和生锈的空罐头盒。在垃圾堆中我发现了一块牌子，上面写着：'凡在此树林里丢弃垃圾者，将依法处置。'

Question: 问题。What was so funny about the words on the sign? 牌子上的字有什么可笑的地方？

问题：牌子上的字有什么可笑的地方？

Notes on the text 课文注释

was covered with …

「被……覆盖」：the ground was covered with pieces of paper, cigarette ends, old tyres, empty bottles and rusty tins.

What I saw made me very sad

句中的主语 what I saw 是一个以 what 引导的名词性从句。

I found a sign which said …

这里的 said 不当「说」讲，而是「写着……」。
